contract.name: StreamingPayments
contract.description: Continuous, linear streaming payments on Stellar (Soroban).

functions.name: create_stream
functions.doc: Creates a linear payment stream and pulls the deposit from the sender.

functions.name: withdraw
functions.doc: Withdraws up to `amount` of the accrued, unwithdrawn balance to the recipient.

functions.name: withdraw_max
functions.doc: Withdraws the entire accrued, unwithdrawn balance and returns the amount paid.

functions.name: cancel_stream
functions.doc: Cancels a stream, paying the recipient their accrued balance and refunding the sender.

functions.name: top_up
functions.doc: Adds funds to an active stream; accrual stays linear over the original window.

functions.name: get_stream
functions.doc: Returns the full stored state of a stream.

functions.name: available
functions.doc: Returns the accrued, unwithdrawn balance at the current ledger time.

functions.name: recipient_streams
functions.doc: Returns a creation-ordered page of stream ids where `recipient` receives funds.

functions.name: sender_streams
functions.doc: Returns a creation-ordered page of stream ids created by `sender`.

structs.name: Stream
structs.doc: Full state of a payment stream.

events.name: StreamCreated
events.doc: Emitted when a new stream is created and its deposit pulled in.

events.name: Withdrawn
events.doc: Emitted when the recipient withdraws accrued funds.

events.name: StreamCancelled
events.doc: Emitted when a stream is cancelled and both parties are paid atomically.

events.name: StreamToppedUp
events.doc: Emitted when the sender adds funds to an existing stream.

errors.name: StreamNotFound
errors.doc: No stream exists with the provided id.

errors.name: NotStreamSender
errors.doc: The caller is not the sender of the stream.

errors.name: NotStreamRecipient
errors.doc: The caller is not the recipient of the stream.

errors.name: StreamNotCancellable
errors.doc: The stream is not cancelable by the recipient.

errors.name: StreamNotActive
errors.doc: The stream is cancelled or depleted.

errors.name: StartTimeInPast
errors.doc: start_time is before the current ledger timestamp.

errors.name: InvalidTimeRange
errors.doc: end_time is not strictly after start_time.

errors.name: DurationTooLong
errors.doc: The stream duration exceeds the maximum.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.doc: A provided amount is zero or negative.

errors.name: AmountExceedsAvailable
errors.doc: The withdrawal exceeds the accrued balance.

errors.name: NotAuthorized
errors.doc: The caller is not permitted to perform this action.
